title: private-deployments-weekly-2026-09-14
content:
Week: 2026-09-08 to 2026-09-14
Owners: Anita Rao (lead), Miguel Torres (ops), Emily Chen (installer), Ravi Singh (security)

Summary:
- Focus this week: unblock two mid-enterprise installs (ACME Corp, NorthStar Health) and finalize VPC peering automation for customer-managed networking.
- Progress on on-prem installer: installer v0.9.2 released to staging (fixes persistent volume mapping + service account permissions).
- New blocker: KMS integration test failing for Azure HSM customers when key rotation is enabled (affects 2 active POCs).
- Next week priorities: hotfix for KMS rotation, complete canary for v0.9.2 on dedicated lab, prepare runbook updates for ACME go-live.

Standup logs (high level)
Mon 2026-09-08:
- ACME: completed pre-install network validation, found subnet tagging mismatch between their infra templates and our docs. Emily to push a PR with a validation script.
- NorthStar: installer run failed at step 4 (kubeadm join timeout). Suspected MTU issue on their VPN. Miguel to run network trace with customer SRE.
- Installer: merged PV mapping fix, started CI e2e on our staging cluster.
- KMS: initial repro of Azure HSM rotation failure (JIRA-PD-1107). Ravi debugging.

Tue 2026-09-09:
- ACME: held 1:1 with their infra lead, they’ll add the tags but want a one-click check from our side. TODO: add --validate-net flag to installer (Emily).
- NorthStar: customer provided tcpdump, MTU mismatch confirmed. Temporary workaround implemented: set jumbo MTU to 1500 on node pool. Long-term: document network requirements.
- VPC peering automation: PoC script for terraform-based peering passed internal review. Need policy guardrails.

Wed 2026-09-10:
- KMS: Ravi reproduced rotation failure in our lab with Azure keywrap enabled. Root cause: client-side library (azure-keyvault lib) upgrade caused nonce mismatch when rotate=true. Raised dependency pin and patch in PR.
- ACME: validation script PR open (PR #123). Emily requested review from infra team.
- On-prem installer: telemetry shows 8% failure rate on step 3 for air-gapped installs (time outs for package retrieval). Investigating package mirroring approach.

Thu 2026-09-11:
- Customer blockers call (attendees: PD leads + support + customer SREs):
  - ACME: blocker resolved once tags added; they requested a preflight check in UI/CLI. Action: add preflight + runbook update (Anita).
  - NorthStar: waiting on updated VPN config from customer. Our workaround ok for now but we need better detection. (Miguel).
  - HealthCloud (pilot): successful on-prem install but failing health-checks due to TLS cert CN mismatch; suggested adding optional SAN validation step in installer.
- Security review: KMS patch needs security sign-off before cutting hotfix. Ravi to schedule security review on Friday.

Fri 2026-09-12:
- Release: rolled v0.9.2 to staging; smoke tests pass except KMS rotation tests. Branch hotfix for Azure KMS created (PR #131).
- Canary plan: run v0.9.2 on lab cluster with 3 internal customers (ACME, InternalQA, Canary-Prod) starting Monday. Monitor for PV mapping issues.
- Internal doc refresh: updated runbook draft for ACME go-live; needs PM review.

Action items / TODOs:
- Emily: add --validate-net flag + preflight script to installer (PR in progress) (due 2026-09-17).
- Miguel: finalize network trace + propose MTU detection heuristic (due 2026-09-16).
- Ravi: complete Azure KMS hotfix PR, get security sign-off, and cut release branch (target 2026-09-15).
- Anita: update ACME runbook and create customer-facing checklist; coordinate go-live (target 2026-09-18).
- Ops: schedule canary run for 2026-09-15 and invite stakeholders (done: calendar invite sent).

Risks / Blockers:
- KMS rotation bug blocks Azure HSM customers with rotation enabled. Impact: two live POCs + one pending enterprise contract. Escalation: security review required; if not fixed by 2026-09-15, propose disabling rotation for affected installs as emergency mitigation.
- Installer timeouts for air-gapped installs: affects onboarding time and CS sentiment. Longer-term solution required (package mirroring and local cache).
- Network preflight coverage is incomplete: customers keep providing slightly different cloud infra templates; need broader heuristics + more tests to avoid manual adjustments.

Notes from customer syncs:
- ACME feedback: "We like Redwood's consistent API but need better preflight tooling — we lost half a day chasing tags." They requested a one-click validation run from our console/CLI.
- NorthStar: want explicit doc for VPN MTU and path MTU testing steps. They’re open to us shipping a small agent to run diagnostics during preflight.
- HealthCloud: requires SOC/PCI-compatible cert handling; they asked for explicit guidance on cert provisioning and rotation timelines.

Decisions made:
- Cut v0.9.2 to staging despite KMS tests failing to allow PV mapping fixes to be validated by customers. KMS hotfix will be a targeted follow-up.
- Prioritize preflight tooling + validation flags for next sprint (RCA from week of 2026-09-14).

Metric updates / telemetry:
- Installer success rate (staging): 92% last 7 days (up from 86% after PV fix).
- Air-gapped installs failure rate: ~8% on step 3.
- Average time-to-onboard (POC): 6.2 days (goal: 3 days).

Meeting notes / attachments:
- Link: Confluence PD install runbook (linked_artifacts above).
- Slack thread: #pd-installs (noted repeated MTU issues).
- Jira: JIRA-PD-1023 (ACME preflight work), JIRA-PD-1107 (Azure KMS rotation).

Unresolved questions / follow-ups:
- Can we safely disable rotation for Azure HSM customers per-tenant while preserving compliance traces? (Security to confirm)
- Do we want to add a small network diagnostic agent to the installer bundle or keep it as a separate binary? Pros/cons list needed.
- Estimate for package mirror MVP for air-gapped installs — who can own? (Engineering ops?)

Notes to self (informal):
- Push for automation on preflight — saves CS time.
- Keep close to security on KMS patch, this is a high-sensitivity area.
- Follow up with PM about increasing onboarding SLA for enterprise POCs.

Next week (short):
- Monday: start v0.9.2 canary + monitor PV mapping metrics.
- Tue/Wed: hotfix cut for Azure KMS if security approves.
- Wed: Draft package mirror plan and schedule design review.
- Friday: PD weekly review with SRE + Security (invite sent).

Attachments: screenshots from ACME preflight run (uploaded to Confluence page), PR links above.
